verification.status_meaning: mapped means a route or component is represented in the theme contract; it is not a visual or functional pass
verification.prior_runtime_audit: The 2026-10-02 local audit reported all 12 routes rendered at desktop and mobile; this is historical evidence, not verification of subsequent edits.
verification.design_boundary: Figma MCP quota blocked complete frame-by-frame exports. Detailed Shop and Product screenshots plus the board overview were available; complete exact visual parity is not established.
verification.functional_boundary: Authenticated account mutations, populated-cart writes, contact submission, checkout and payment were not exercised in the prior local audit.
